name: morph-ai-website

scripts.build: next build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const sa=p.join('.next','standalone');const root=fs.existsSync(p.join(sa,'server.js'))?sa:p.join(sa,'morph');fs.cpSync(p.join('.next','static'),p.join(root,'.next','static'),{recursive:true});fs.cpSync('public',p.join(root,'public'),{recursive:true});if(fs.existsSync('.env')){fs.copyFileSync('.env',p.join(root,'.env'));console.log('[build] .env copied into standalone bundle')}console.log('[build] standalone assets copied to '+root)"

description: Morph AI - Virtual Try-On API for Fashion E-commerce (Next.js 16 + TypeScript)
